lines.en: : I’m telling you, it was an accident! If I had known that was Ami, of course I wouldn’t have used my tongue!
: Maya, I understand that you are in love with me, but you really need to ask permission before doing that sort of thing.
: Maybe she tried and you just didn’t hear her because of where your tongues were?
: Why are neither of you listening to me?! I’m telling you that’s not what happened! I seriously had no idea!
: Well, I’m sorry Maya but it’s just really hard to believe you didn’t know when we literally talked about it beforehand.
: Yeah, this just sounds like an excuse to me. But if you’re worried about getting too carried away, don’t be.
: At least you got permission. That’s one whole step ahead of Molly and you both kissed the same amount of girls tonight.
: Oh my fucking- no! You’re not listening to me!
: Something’s going on! I’m...I’m not myself.
: Of course you are, Maya! It doesn’t matter to either one of us which gender you prefer. You’ll always be Maya to us.
: You have roughly thirty seconds left to live.
: Maya, stop. Making threats isn’t going to change anything. But I don’t want to make a big deal out of this so let’s just chalk it up to a...misunderstanding and agree to not speak about it anymore.
: Fine! Okay! Whatever! That still doesn’t change the fact that something is seriously wrong with me all of a sudden!
: There’s-
: Twenty seconds, Ayane. Don’t even think about making another joke.
: What do you mean by “something is wrong” though? We still have no clue what that means.
: Yeah, the timeline for us has been: Maya and Ami kiss, Maya uses tongue, Ami screams, we all leave the room. At what point did something go wrong?
: Before that! Do you want to hear my timeline? Halloween. Different Halloween. Makeout session with Ami’s uncle. Makeout session with Ami. Who’s next? Fucking Noriko?
: Who?
: AAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHH!!!!
: Just go along with it. She’s clearly having some sort of episode right now.
: I’m not having a fucking episode! The world is clearly breaking and no one seems to be aware of it but me!
: It’s like every five minutes I’m getting sent to a different place in time!
: So what’s to stop me from making out with literally everyone if it’s just going to be erased in a little while?!

: I’ll go next if it’ll make you feel better. I’m not really into girls, but I won’t lie in saying that I’m feeling kind of left out that your feelings for Ami are so much stronger than your feelings for me.
: It was rhetorical, Ayane! I’m not actually going to do that!
: Just like you weren’t going to use your tongue on Ami, right?
: Ayane, shush. Maya, if something’s actually wrong, shouldn’t you lie down? There’s gotta be some kind of infirmary thingy here, right?
: That’s exactly how this whole thing started, Ami! You and me were hanging out. Then we were somewhere else.

: So you said we should lie down in Ayane’s weird hospital room thing. And I agreed. Then I brought up the threesome and you told Molly to get drunk. After that, it’s been like 90%% kissing. I’m going insane!
: You sure are. I don’t even know what threesome you’re talking about.
: You, me, and Sensei! It was your idea!
: Why do you guys keep leaving me out of stuff?! We can easily make it a foursome instead!
: Hey, can you guys maybe not say stuff like that directly in front of Sensei? Thanks.
: Oh! Hi, Sensei. Now the games can really begin.
: Sorry, what’s going on out here exactly? Because the rest of the girls are wondering when you’re all going to be going back in there for round two.
: Sensei! Where were we just a minute ago?! You remember, right?
: The...hotel room?
: Before that, idiot!
: The...lobby?
: GAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHHHHH!!!!!!
: Don’t pay her any mind, Sensei. Maya’s decided to come up with some weird story about jumping through time because she’s embarrassed about getting too lesbian with Ami.
: No, Ayane. I think there’s something true about what Maya’s saying. Like, maybe not for us. But what if she actually is part of some weird time-hopping thingy? What do we do to fix it?
: Yes! Thank you, Ami! These are the questions we need to be asking! The next jump could happen any second now!
: Sorry, I’m confused again. Are you saying that the only reason you put your tongue in Ami’s mouth was because you were putting your tongue in my mouth in an alternate timeline beforehand?
: Yes! Exactly!
: And you just...happened to teleport to another place in time where you were also making out with someone?
: Oh, Maya. I had no idea you were this promiscuous...
: I’m not promiscuous! It was like...kissing probably triggered it?!
: Then why not try triggering it again?
: Good idea. Let’s do it.
: Wait, with me? I meant that you should kiss one of the girls again. That was hot as hell. And you’re always calling me a creepy stalker anyway.

: Yeah, well there’s no more pressure on me to save face when you’ve already decided to dump me for your stupid childhood friend. I’m going all out now. And that involves making out with you in front of your niece.
: Yeah, I’d really prefer you didn’t do that.
: Do you at least want to hide behind the excuse of spin the bottle? Because I’m pretty sure I’ve figured out a trick where I can just spin it really softly and have it land on whoever I-
: Your mouth. My mouth. Now.
: Mmm!
: Somebody help! Maya’s going on a kissing rampage and blaming it all on time!
: And what’s even worse is she’s leaving me out of it!
: Let...the record show...
: I...have nothing to do...with this...
: This is...all her...
: Wait, hold on. Does anyone else hear-
: Mm! Mlmn...mmnfh! Mmmnh!
Somewhere you’re not/somewhere you are\nSomewhere it’s close/somewhere it’s far
That gash in your hands/the one on your leg\nIt matches my eyes/that same shade of red
So why do you run?/Why do you hide?\nIf the memories fade/why not keep them inside?
I’ve always been here/You’re never alone\nOur love is a house/We can make it a home
A room for your pain/a room for your doubt\nA room for your sister/A place to black out
If death is a lake/we’ll dive in as one\nOur feet touch the sand/Our hearts touch the sun
Remember the smell/Remember the light\nRemember to smile/Remember I might
But only if you can/forget everything\nIf you promise me that/I’ll repair these old wings
And we’ll fly off together to a place no one can reach us.
THIS IS SUPPOSED TO BE MY STORY
The girl with the me who is me who is Ami I am Ami CAN YOU HEAR ME?
: Wait...stop.
: We can’t.
: You’re just...
: We shouldn’t.
: What the...
: ...Maya?
: What day is it?...
: Uhh...a few days after Christmas I think? I haven’t really been keeping track.
: And how long have I been here?
: I’m...not really sure when the last time you left is. What’s gotten into you?
: Nothing, I just...
: It’s been a...weird day.
: But I’m happy here...
: And if the world ends right now, I won’t care.
: That’s a good line.
: I’ve been keeping it in my back pocket while waiting for a special moment. I figure this’ll be the best I get.
: You can keep going, you know. You don’t have to hold back for my sake.
: I love you, Akira.
: No. No, you can’t say that. That’s enough for today.
: Huh?! Why?! I don’t want this to be over yet. I just got here!
: Yeah, but things have already gone way too far. And I can’t...I can’t say those words back to you. Not the way I am now. Probably never.
: I’m sorry...We should just...We should end this before we let it go any further.
: Is this...really how it went back then?...
: How what went? What are you talking about?
: Do you...mind if I sound a little crazy for a second?
: Not at all...go right ahead.
: I’ve spent the last hour or two swimming through a montage of nonsense. Multiple seasons. Multiple holidays. I even kissed your niece.
: Wait, how do you even know about-

: Just shut the fuck up, okay? I’m not the Maya who was here a second ago. I’m a new one — the result of what this turns into. And it might...suck sometimes, yeah. But I still wouldn’t trade it for the world.
: Does that make you a deplorable, terrible person? Yes. But you’re my deplorable, terrible person. And I need you to be that way, because you being utterly despicable is what keeps me grounded.
: Maya-
: Never leave me. Ever. Ever. Ever. Ever. Ever. Ever. Ever. And I promise you — I will do the same.
: This is way more than just “a little crazy.” You know that, right?

: Yeah. And if you said that like three teleportations ago, I would have agreed and shut the fuck up about it. But I have no idea when this is going to end and if these moments are going to impact anything.
: What are you even-

: Years and years from now, when I’m older, you’re going to have doubts about me. Something’s going to happen and...you’ll fall out of love. Or maybe you won’t. I don’t...I don’t really get what happens yet.
: But I never listened when you tried to tell me. And I’m sorry for that. I should have listened.
: Because now I’m doing the same thing and...I’m so afraid of losing you that it’s not even funny.
: So I want you to say it right now. I want you to say that you love me. And I want you to promise me that nothing- no childhood friend or...time itself will ever change that.
: It’s still too soon, Maya...

: Bullshit! You know it’s true! What difference does a year or two make at this point?! Just fucking say it, okay?! I need to hear it at least one more time! Even if you’re lying! I can just tell myself you’re not!
: It’s time to go, Maya.
: Don’t you fucking do this, Akira.
: I’m not Akira. I’m not even here.
: No! Shut the fuck up! This one has to be real! I can’t handle much more of this!
: Aww...Well I’ve got really bad news then! Because the worst is yet to come. Or maybe the best depending on how you look at it?
: Hah...hahahah...
: You made me use that great line for nothing, didn’t you?...
: It was very impressive. But yes, I guess so.
: Who are you, huh?...
: My conscience?
: The devil on my shoulder?
: Is this supposed to be some kind of “trial?”
: Am I dead?
: And if not, what am I?
: Maybe you’re asleep?
: God, I fucking hope so. This has been the most immersive nightmare of my life if that’s the case.
: Blah, blah, blah. You ready to “wake up” now?
: Fuck you.
: YOUR WISH IS MY COMMAND.
: I get it now.
: I’m in Hell.
: Mayaaaaa? Are you awake yet?
: Pardon the intrusion! But look! I brought a gift for you!
Ami enters the room!
Isn’t she just the cutest?
